_comment: Phase 2 (#491): roots use the audited per-surface root counts; finished lexicon words use the full joint CMU population. Both stages retain zero inventory loss. Distribution limits are worst ± 3 sample SDs from five non-overlapping streams of 200,000 words per stage, rounded outward. These are separate calibrations against different populations than the legacy gate. The fit changes root lengths, codas and affix rates; the remaining phoneme mismatches are tracked as diagnostic gaps. See docs/cmu-root-reference.md.
